item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00010","case1_error":"Introduces an unsupported $3,000 tax charge; 20% of the $5,000 pretax profit is $1,000.","case2_error":"Omits the $150 fixed rental fee, reporting only mileage charges.","reason":"The first inserts an unsupported expense amount; the second leaves a stated expense out of the total.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00011","case1_error":"Treats 80 yards as the required width increase, omitting the initial 50 yards.","case2_error":"Treats the turtle's full 20-second race time as its head start, omitting subtraction of the hare's 2 seconds.","reason":"Both substitute a full quantity for a required difference by omitting the baseline subtraction.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J00012","case1_error":"Omits the flat $20 reservation fee from the total deposit.","case2_error":"Subtracts the $25 conditional gift despite correctly finding that Kathleen does not qualify.","reason":"The first omits a required charge; the second introduces an unjustified deduction for an unreceived gift.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00013","case1_error":"States the correct formulas but supplies an unsupported final answer of 19 instead of 9.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 20 − (2 + 4 + 1 + 4) as 11 instead of 9.","reason":"The first gives a wrong final number without showing its evaluation; the second explicitly miscalculates a correctly written expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00014","case1_error":"Uses 12 birds per snake instead of the stated 3 when calculating birds consumed.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 580 − 140 − 56 − 35 as 359 instead of 349.","reason":"The first substitutes an incorrect rate into the relationship; the second makes a numerical evaluation error in a correct expression.","judgment":"different"}]}
